data.one_liner: Start.io (StartApp) SDK for Flutter to show ads using native platform views.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that integrates the Start.io advertising network to display banners, interstitials, rewarded videos, and native ads. It utilizes native platform views to render ads on Android and iOS.
use_when: You want to monetize your mobile app using the Start.io ad network
Your app targets both Android and iOS platforms
You need standard ad formats like banners, interstitials, or rewarded videos
avoid_when: You prefer using a different ad network such as Google AdMob
You are building a web or desktop application
strengths: Supports multiple ad formats including Banner, MREC, Cover, Interstitial, Rewarded Video, and Native ads
Provides built-in test mode for development
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist
Interstitial and rewarded video instances can only be displayed once and must be reloaded
data.setup_notes: Requires adding your App ID to AndroidManifest.xml for Android and Info.plist for iOS.

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use Google AdMob and Ad Manager instead of the Start.io network.
